svg.title: Relay · responsibility map
svg.desc: Responsibility assignment matrix as of 2026-09-29. Letters and confirmation state are distinct. Counts are not utilization.
svg.text: Inspect each delivery relationship, its confirmation state, and the evidence needed to rely on it.
R performs · A owns the result · C is consulted · I is informed · ? unresolved · — no assignment
Solid = confirmed · dashed = proposed or unknown · red outline = disputed. Letter and confirmation are separate dimensions.
8 rows · 6 roles · 8 rows with review findings. Counts indicate assignment patterns, not workload or capacity.
